t: A block based game design course for grade 2 and up with an AI tutor.
steps: Create a free teacher account on the Kodable site.
Ask the school for approval before adding students.
Add students through Google Classroom, Clever, or a class code.
Assign the first course, such as High Flyer.
Check what CatBot is and decide if students will use it.
Confirm the plan and price with the vendor.
